sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: Sigmoid.forward direct branch only. The separate Logit subclass argument bug is explicitly documented.

sourceFacts: Sigmoid source implements a real direct/inverse bijector and returns the sum of log derivative.
Logit subclass passes inverse as the second positional cond_inputs argument, leaving mode=direct. It is therefore not drawn as a correctly implemented logit wrapper.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
